title: Blood glucose
text: Follow the meter's instructions exactly: clean dry hands, an adequate blood drop, a current test strip, and the control check the maker requires.

Below 70 mg/dL scores watch and below 54 scores critical; 200 or above scores watch and 250 or above scores critical (ADA Standards of Care). Low blood sugar with confusion, shaking or sweating needs fast sugar and the crew medical officer at once.

citations.source: ADA Standards of Care: hypoglycaemia levels 1 and 2; random plasma glucose diagnostic threshold; DKA threshold.
